notes.title: The Curse of Faces arrives at gamescom
notes.content:
[h2]Hello travelers to Yariv, [/h2][h2][/h2][h3]Our team has great news to share: [/h3][p]We are exhibiting at gamescom Cologne! If you are planning to be there, you have one mission: 
Find the CobraTekku Games booth in [b]hall 10.2 at the HOME of INDIES[/b] group booth.[/p][p][/p][p][b]This will be your reward:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Chance to play a unique gamescom version with never-before-seen weapons, enemies and bosses[/p][/*][*][p]Loot some limited merchandise[/p][/*][*][p]Have a friendly chat with the team behind the game[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you can't attend gamescom, don't worry: Maybe you haven't played our updated demo, so give it a try! And if you already did that, perhaps you want to start a new character - some of our Discord community members already reached level 100 with their characters, so what is your excuse? [/p][p][/p][p]We are looking forward to meeting you all! [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048979/c337bbceec261c0b68d71df73084a604d8c22a27.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: BIG DEMO UPDATE
notes.content: [h2]Hello travelers to Yariv, [/h2][p][/p][p]As we work on the main game, we are implementing numerous improvements and moving closer to our final vision. [/p][p]However, we don't want to keep it from you, so we've decided to update the demo and give you a small glimpse of our work behind the scenes. [/p][p][/p][h3]The new demo contains: [/h3][p][b]New Content --------------------------------------------------------------[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Reworked texture for almost every object in the game![/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New and more polished tutorial (Black and White Forest)[/b][/p][/*][*][p]New tree models in the forest area [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Improvements[/b] [b]------------------------------------------------------------[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improvements to Mask Altar UI [/p][/*][*][p]Better scrolling in menus with the mouse scroll [/p][/*][*][p]Better display of shield's passive defence in inventory [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Changes -------------------------------------------------------------------[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Broken Sword received a damage and reach buff [/p][/*][*][p]Barrels' durability changed: 150HP --> 70HP [/p][/*][*][p]Burn and poison deal more damage to enemies [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Glitches -------------------------------------------------------------------[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Brawler ring HP decrease bug fixed [/p][/*][*][p]More minor bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Play the new demo for yourself and let us know what you think - either as a Steam review or in our active Discord: [url="https://discord.com/invite/drJzkyDeBa"]https://discord.com/invite/drJzkyDeBa[/url][/p][p][/p][p]I wish you great adventures in Yariv! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048979/2f3fbb78ba80f3c46c4a3d0049622a8236b216f9.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Thanks for 4k wishlist and Happy 2025!
notes.content:
[h3]Happy 2025 everyone! 
[/h3]
Today Verho reached 4k wishlists and it's amazing because just 7 days ago we were celebrating 3k.
I wanted to thank you all and for the first time announce that the demo will receive a[b] new update at the end of January[/b].

[h3]Here is what the new update for demo will include:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New Npc with a new quest[/b] that will change early progression a bit.
[*] [b]Graphical improvement[/b] is in most areas, the biggest one being in Rotten Valley.
[*] Change a lot of bloom, for the rotten Valley, and [b]YES, torch too![/b]
[*] [b]Galecrasher [/b]will receive a new longer description and Sword Magic which will be its special attack.
[*] New Ambient sounds to each area.
[*] Some new descriptions and [b]spelling mistakes[/b] will be fixed.
[/list]

[h3]When it comes to how full game development is going
[/h3]
I would say it's going pretty well. If you're interested in seeing daily updates, you can join our Discord server, where you can talk with developers daily and see full game progression in real time!

Discord Link: https://discord.gg/4x8S893eYq

notes.title: Demo Updates 27-29.3 Change Log
notes.content:
[h2]Here are some changes from 3 post-lunch updates of the demo!
[/h2]Let me know how you like it, and if you want to talk with me or other members of community be sure to join verho [b]Discord Server[/b]! 
https://discord.gg/4x8S893eYq

[h1]Change log:
[/h1]

[h2]Improvements
[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Hanger’s Sounds 
[*] New Footstpes Sounds 
[*] In game keyboard for name input field while playing on gamepad
[*] More Visible inactive Mask Altars
[*] Weak spell sooner in the game
[*] More Visible Manual
[*] Fall damage nerf
[*] Abillity to use Usable items from inventory
[*] Smaller Contact Hitboxes
[*] Worms and Bat Damaging only if chagring on to player
[*] Easier jumps in Red Cavern
[*] UI Mouse Controll
[*] Loading Screens
[*] New Credits
[*] Pixel Effect can be now disabled in options
[*] Head anim can be now disabled in options
[*] Optional Crosshair
[*] Invincibility Frames while traveling and resting
[*] Crouch lock
[*] Smother Crouch
[*] Player can no longer crouch in air
[*] Minor changes to Red Cavern layout
[*] Yariv pass changed
[*] Corrupted Core more visible animation
[*] Some Spelling Mistakes (All from discord server not counting ones in Manual)
[*] Modified background in Temple to match future location
[*] New Easter in Nameless Village
[/list]


[h2]System Changes
[/h2]
[b]New Enemies Resitst System
[/b]   [u] [Old Systeam ][/u]
All enemies had weakness +50% dmg, resistance -50% dmg, immunity -100% dmg
[u]  [New System]
[/u]All enemies have a value of -100% to 300% to all elements damage types
Also, all weapons have no Slashing, Blunt, or Thrust damage and all enemies have unique         
esistance.


[h2]Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Better Shields, now give passive Defence and can cancel end of attack animation.
[*] Poisoned Biters are now a bit slower
[/list]

[h2]Gliches
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Temple Outdoor, stone path missing hitbox fixe
[*] Save not saving last level up
[*] Pressing Esc while Rotten Valley cutscene froze the game
[*] Some hints have End, and should Esc
[*] Invisible Ladder Fixed
[*] Drop from Giant Worm, can’t glitch anymore
[*] Hunger pathfinding fixed in portal room
[*] Fixed wrong name in last note from Kurath City [Perantius(snake name) -> Azarion(correct name)]
[*] Barrels no sound while not hitting directly fixed
[*] Spear Elemental Buff Fixed
[*] Voices volume always set on value of Sounds Fixed
[*] Cannot move while blocking on Controller Fixes
[*] Softlock while unlocking 1st mask altar without resting
[/list]
